startUrls.title: Property URLs
startUrls.description: Expedia, Hotels.com or Vrbo property page URLs. Regional domains such as expedia.it or de.hotels.com work too, and extra query parameters are ignored. Open Advanced on a URL to attach any `userData` - it comes back on every review from that property as `customData`.

maxReviewsPerHotel.title: Max reviews per property
maxReviewsPerHotel.description: Stop after this many reviews for each property. Leave empty to scrape all of them.

sortBy.title: Sort reviews by
sortBy.description: Which reviews come first, which decides what you get when you also set a maximum per property. Reviews are fetched in parallel, so the dataset is not ordered - use the `reviewPosition` field to restore the ranking.

minDate.title: Skip reviews older than
minDate.description: Only scrape reviews submitted on or after this date. Requires sorting by Most recent, because that is the only order that runs newest-first; it is ignored otherwise.

debugLog.title: Debug log
debugLog.description: Log every request and page in detail, to troubleshoot an unexpected run.
